name: freecad-mcp-bridge
description: Connect to a running FreeCAD session through the FreeCAD MCP Bridge addon.
long_description:
Connects to an open FreeCAD session, so Claude can run Python in FreeCAD and read the output.

Needs FreeCAD's MCP Bridge addon. Setup instructions are in the [README on GitHub](https://github.com/CREATeNG/freecad-mcp-bridge#readme).

port.title: FreeCAD MCP Bridge port
port.description: Requires the MCP Bridge addon installed and switched on in FreeCAD. Must match the Port in FreeCAD's Edit → Preferences → MCP Bridge. Extension 0.1.26.
